script_text: Hold your breath, Taurus — the cosmos is flashing a red alert just for you. Venus, your ruling planet, glides through Pisces and forms a precise sextile to Pluto in Capricorn right now. This sextile lights up your 12th house of inner healing and your 10th house of public status. Meanwhile, Saturn in Pisces trines your natal Venus, anchoring mystical insights into practical reality. In love, the Venus-Pluto sextile pulls hidden desires to the surface, inviting a deeper, soulful bond with your partner — or, if single, drawing someone who mirrors your inner depth and honors your Earth nature. Financially, Saturn's trine to Venus in your 2nd house of resources brings a stable income rise, perhaps from an investment or a raise tied to your creative talents. Avoid impulsive splurges today; channel the unexpected gift of intuitive insight into a concrete plan. Subscribe so you don't miss what's coming this week.
